name: Stolthaven Dagenham

name: DFDS Vlaardingen (Rotterdam) Terminal
description: DFDS-operated ro-ro terminal in Vlaardingen (22.9 hectares and three berths up to 230 m), where DFDS runs its own vessels to UK ports.

geoQueries: DFDS Seaways Riverside Terminal Humber Road Immingham

name: DFDS North Sea Terminal Brevik
description: DFDS operates the North Sea Terminal in Brevik, with two ro-ro berths up to 250 m and two lo-lo berths, and publishes the 2026 terminal tariff.

name: DFDS Mercatordok Terminal Ghent
description: DFDS operates the Mercatordok Multimodal Terminal in Ghent, a 240,000 m2 stevedoring terminal with two berths up to 300 m and a 2026 terminal tariff.

name: DSV Horsens Logistics Centre

name: DSV Venlo Fulfilment Factory (Popeweg)

name: DSV Venlo Automated Warehouse (Logistiekweg)
description: DSV operates this automated Venlo warehouse at Logistiekweg 2 (83,000 m2, goods-to-person ASRS, pick-by-light and an automated pack line).

name: DSV Moerdijk Logistics Campus
description: DSV operates this Logistiek Park Moerdijk campus at Exportweg 1, with more than 200,000 m2 of warehousing on over 34 hectares, as a European contract-logistics hub.

name: DSV Rosersberg Logistics Centre
description: DSV operates this logistics centre north of Stockholm (68,000 m2 warehouse, an AutoStore of about 28,000 bins and 12,000 m2 of temperature-controlled pharmaceutical storage).
